lines.beaver_en: Why did you want to see me? I'm busy.
lines.learner: 지난번 회의 때 티격태격한 일 때문에요.
lines.en: It's about how we bickered at the last meeting.
lines.roman: jinanbeon hoeui ttae tigyeoktaegyeokan il ttaemuneyo.

lines.beaver_en: You were the one who picked on me first.
lines.en: You're right. I'm sorry I found fault for no reason.

lines.beaver_en: That day, only I got scolded by the manager.
lines.learner: 저 때문에 야단맞게 해서 정말 죄송해요.
lines.en: I'm really sorry you got scolded because of me.
lines.roman: jeo ttaemune yadanmatge haeseo jeongmal joesonghaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: You spoke ill of me in front of others, didn't you?
lines.en: I didn't mean to bad-mouth you, but I said too much.

lines.beaver_en: Everyone gave me dirty looks, and it was hard.
lines.en: Even I turned my back on you, so you were really hurt, right?

lines.beaver: 네, 솔직히 믿음을 저버린 것 같았어요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, honestly it felt like you betrayed my trust.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, soljiki mideumeul jeobeorin geot gatasseoyo.
lines.learner: 제가 믿음을 저버린 것 같아 마음이 무거워요.
lines.en: I feel heavy-hearted that I let down your trust.
lines.roman: jega mideumeul jeobeorin geot gata maeumi mugeowoyo.

lines.beaver: 사실 저도 부장님께 대든 건 잘못했어요.
lines.beaver_en: Actually, I was wrong to talk back to the manager too.
lines.beaver_roman: sasil jeodo bujangnimkke daedeun geon jalmotaesseoyo.
lines.en: I also grumbled behind your back and even slandered you.

lines.beaver_en: How did things get this bad between us?
lines.learner: 작은 시비가 반목으로 커진 것 같아요.
lines.en: I think a small quarrel grew into real hostility.
lines.roman: jageun sibiga banmogeuro keojin geot gatayo.

lines.beaver_en: Right. Even the team's mood got worse.
lines.en: If the discord goes on, even our work will get tangled.

lines.beaver: 이제 어떻게 할 거예요? 저도 노력할게요.
lines.beaver_en: So what now? I'll make an effort too.
lines.beaver_roman: ije eotteoke hal geoyeyo? jeodo noryeokalgeyo.
lines.learner: 앞으론 서운한 일이 있으면 먼저 대화해요.
lines.en: From now on, if something hurts, let's talk first.
lines.roman: apeuron seounhan iri isseumyeon meonjeo daehwahaeyo.
